title: Incorrect condition
detail: The condition `if self.show_envvar and self.envvar:` will not handle cases where `self.envvar` is an empty list or string, which should be considered as `None` in this context. The same applies to line 3446.

title: Incorrect option creation
detail: The option creation `click.Option(['--units'], envvar=envvar, show_envvar=True)` will not handle cases where `envvar` is an empty list or string, which should be considered as `None` in this context. The same applies to line 1050.

title: Incorrect header handling
detail: The code overwrites the 'Content-Type' header with the same value, which is redundant and does not handle different cases of the header name.

title: Missing charset handling
detail: The code does not extract the charset from the 'Content-Type' header and uses it to encode the payload.

title: Missing return value
detail: The reset method does not return a value, which may cause issues in calling code that expects a boolean.

title: Incorrect type annotation
detail: The type annotation for _streams is incorrect. It should be a list of NetworkStream objects.

title: Incorrect list comprehension
detail: The list comprehension to filter closed streams is incorrect. It should check if the stream is closed.

title: Incorrect method signature
detail: The _reset method in HTTPParser is async, but HTTPStream expects a synchronous method. This will cause a TypeError when calling _reset.

title: Unnecessary read operation
detail: Reading from the stream after it has been reset is unnecessary and may cause unexpected behavior.
